api_token.description: Token for Forgejo API. May also be provided via FORGEJO_API_TOKEN environment variable.

host.description: URI for Forgejo API. May also be provided via FORGEJO_HOST environment variable.

otp.description: OTP (One-Time Password) for two-factor authentication with basic auth. Only used with basic auth (username/password). May also be provided via FORGEJO_OTP environment variable.

password.description: Password for Forgejo API. May also be provided via FORGEJO_PASSWORD environment variable.

username.description: Username for Forgejo API. May also be provided via FORGEJO_USERNAME environment variable.

block.description:
Terraform provider for Forgejo — self-hosted lightweight software forge.

Refer to the project's [README](https://github.com/kfkonrad/terraform-provider-forgejo#readme)
for detailed usage examples and troubleshooting information.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the access token.

scopes.description:
Set of scopes for the access token. Allowed values:
  - `all`
  - `public-only`
  - `sudo`
  - `read:activitypub`
  - `write:activitypub`
  - `read:admin`
  - `write:admin`
  - `read:issue`
  - `write:issue`
  - `read:misc`
  - `write:misc`
  - `read:notification`
  - `write:notification`
  - `read:organization`
  - `write:organization`
  - `read:package`
  - `write:package`
  - `read:repository`
  - `write:repository`
  - `read:user`
  - `write:user`

token.description: The actual access token value. This is only available when the token is first created and cannot be retrieved later.

username.description: Username of the user to create the token for. This explicitly specifies which user owns the token.

block.description: Forgejo access token resource. Manages personal access tokens for API authentication.

permission.description: Repository permissions of the collaborator. Allowed values: `read`, `write`, `admin`.

created_at.description: Time at which the deploy key was created.

key.description: Armored SSH key. Trailing newlines must be removed (e.g. using trimspace() function).

key_id.description: Numeric identifier of the deploy key.

read_only.description: Does the key have only read access?

created_at.description: Time at which the GPG key was created.

emails.description: Emails associated with the GPG key.

expires_at.description: Time at which the GPG key expires.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the GPG key.

primary_key_id.description: Primary ID of the GPG key.

repo_admin_change_team_access.description: Whether repository admin can add and remove access for teams. Defaults to `true`.

visibility.description: Visibility of the organization. Allowed values: `public` (default), `limited`, `private`.

created_at.description: Time at which the secret was created.

name.description: Name of the variable. Must contain only uppercase letters, digits, and underscores, and start with a letter.

allow_manual_merge.description: Allowed to manually merge pull requests? Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

allow_merge_commits.description: Allowed to create merge commit? Defaults to `true`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

allow_rebase.description: Allowed to rebase then fast-forward? Defaults to `true`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

allow_rebase_explicit.description: Allowed to rebase then create merge commit? Defaults to `true`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

allow_squash_merge.description: Allowed to create squash commit? Defaults to `true`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

archive_on_destroy.description: Archive the repo instead of delete?

archived.description: Is the repository archived? Defaults to `false`.

auth_token.description: API token for authenticating with migrate / clone URL. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `clone_addr` is set.

auto_init.description: Whether the repository should be auto-intialized? Defaults to `true`.

autodetect_manual_merge.description: Auto-detect manual pull request merges? Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

created_at.description: Time at which the repository was created.

default_merge_style.description: Default merge style of the repository. Allowed values: `merge` (default), `rebase`, `rebase-merge`, `squash`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

external_tracker_format.description: External Issue Tracker URL Format. Use the placeholders `{user}`, `{repo}` and `{index}` for the username, repository name and issue index.

external_tracker_style.description: External Issue Tracker Number Format. Allowed values: `numeric` (default), `alphanumeric`, `regexp`.

external_tracker.description: Settings for external issue tracker. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_issues` is `true`.

external_wiki.description: Settings for external wiki. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_wiki` is `true`.

forks_count.description: Number of forks of the repository.

has_actions.description: Are integrated CI/CD pipelines enabled? Defaults to `true`.

has_issues.description: Is the repository issue tracker enabled? Defaults to `true`.

has_packages.description: Is the repository package registry enabled? Defaults to `true`.

has_projects.description: Are repository projects enabled? Defaults to `true`.

has_pull_requests.description: Are repository pull requests enabled? Defaults to `true`.

has_releases.description: Are repository releases enabled? Defaults to `true`.

has_wiki.description: Is the repository wiki enabled? Defaults to `true`.

ignore_whitespace_conflicts.description: Are whitespace conflicts ignored? Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_pull_requests` is `true`.

allow_only_contributors_to_track_time.description: Let only contributors track time? Defaults to `true`.

enable_issue_dependencies.description: Enable dependencies for issues and pull requests? Defaults to `true`.

internal_tracker.description: Settings for built-in issue tracker. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `has_issues` is `true`.

labels.description: Whether to migrate labels. Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `clone_addr` is set.

lfs.description: Whether to migrate LFS files. Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `clone_addr` is set.

lfs_endpoint.description: LFS endpoint to use. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `lfs` is `true`.

milestones.description: Whether to migrate milestones. Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `clone_addr` is set.

mirror.description: Is the repository a mirror? Defaults to `false`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `clone_addr` is set.

mirror_interval.description: Mirror interval of the repository. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `mirror` is `true`.

mirror_updated.description: Time at which the repository mirror was updated.

open_issues_count.description: Number of open issues of the repository.

open_pr_counter.description: Number of open pull requests of the repository.

owner.description: Owner of the repository (user or organization).

parent_id.description: Numeric identifier of the parent repository.

private.description: Is the repository private? Defaults to `false`.

readme.description: Readme of the repository to create.

release_counter.description: Number of releases of the repository.

service.description: Service to migrate from. Allowed values: `git`, `github`, `gitlab`, `forgejo`, `gitea`, `gogs`. **Note**: This setting is only effective if `clone_addr` is set.

size.description: Size of the repository in KiB.

stars_count.description: Number of stars of the repository.

template.description: Is the repository a template? Defaults to `false`.

trust_model.description: TrustModel of the repository. Allowed values: `default` (default), `collaborator`, `committer`, `collaboratorcommitter`.

updated_at.description: Time at which the repository was updated.

watchers_count.description: Number of watchers of the repository.

created_at.description: Time at which the secret was created.

name.description: Name of the variable. Must contain only uppercase letters, digits, and underscores, and start with a letter.

block_on_official_review_requests.description: Block merge on official review requests. Defaults to `false`.

block_on_outdated_branch.description: Block merge if pull request is outdated. Defaults to `false`.

block_on_rejected_reviews.description: Block merge on rejected reviews. Defaults to `false`.

branch_name.description: The branch name matched by this rule.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the branch rule was created.

dismiss_stale_approvals.description: Dismiss stale approvals when new commits are pushed. Defaults to `false`.

enable_approvals_whitelist.description: Restrict approvals to whitelisted users or teams. Defaults to `false`.

enable_push.description: Enable push to the protected branch. Defaults to `false`.

protected_file_patterns.description: Protected file patterns (semicolon-separated glob patterns). Defaults to `""`.

push_whitelist_deploy_keys.description: Whitelist deploy keys with write access to push. Defaults to `false`.

required_approvals.description: Number of required approvals. Defaults to `0`.

unprotected_file_patterns.description: Unprotected file patterns (semicolon-separated glob patterns). Defaults to `""`.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the branch rule was last updated.

block.description: Forgejo repository branch rule resource. Manages branch protection rules for repositories.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the tag rule was created.

id.description: Numeric identifier of the tag protection rule.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of when the tag rule was last updated.

whitelist_teams.description: Whitelisted teams for creating matching tags.

whitelist_usernames.description: Whitelisted users for creating matching tags.

block.description: Forgejo repository tag rule resource. Manages tag protection rules for repositories.

active.description: Whether the webhook is active. Defaults to `true`.

authorization_header.description: Authorization header value for webhook delivery.

branch_filter.description: Branch filter for webhook events. Only triggers on matching branches.

config.description: Additional configuration options specific to webhook type.

content_type.description: The content type to deliver the payload. Defaults to `json`.

secret.description: Secret used to validate payload signatures.

url.description: URL where payloads will be delivered.

action_run_recover.description: Trigger on action run success after the last action run in the same workflow failed.

pull_request_comment.description: Trigger on pull request comment added/removed/modified.

pull_request_label.description: Trigger on pull request label added/removed.

pull_request_milestone.description: Trigger on pull request milestone added/removed/modified.

pull_request_review.description: Trigger on pull request review approved/rejected/review comment added.

pull_request_review_request.description: Trigger on pull request review request added/removed.

pull_request_sync.description: Trigger on pull request sync (new commits pushed/force-pushed).
